content:
anna_cs: Heads up — we have an incident impacting onboarding ingest jobs (embedding generation). Started ~02:30 UTC; ~12 tenants affected (mix of trials and SMB). Need a short customer note + office hours. @matt_reliability @sanjay_eng can you confirm root cause and ETA?

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-031 created by anna_cs — Severity: S2 — bridge: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-031

sanjay_eng: Root cause = regression in batch-splitter after yesterday's batching-lib upgrade. When a single ingest >10k docs hits the splitter it times out and surfaces 5xx. Rolling a fix to canary now. Estimated rollback + patch in ~45m.

matt_reliability: Canary looks good on p-2 region (no 5xx for last 7m). We'll roll with staged traffic (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Expecting full recovery within ~90m from now. Will post customer-facing note once canary is stable.

lia_onboarding: Thanks. CS asks: include a short mitigation customers can run (small-batch fallback) + a one-time onboarding credit offer. Also need CSV of affected accounts to do personalized outreach.

sanjay_eng: Mitigation we can safely suggest: set ingestion to small-batch mode to avoid the splitter path. Example quick command for customers (needs API key owner):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"s3://bucket/path","batch_mode":"small"}'
```
We can also provide a tiny helper script from support.

anna_cs: Draft outbound below — please review tone + subject. Keep it short, empathetic, and include office hours link + credit offer.

anna_cs: ```Subject: Update on your onboarding ingest — short delay and next steps

Hi —

We’re reaching out with a quick status update: some onboarding ingest jobs that create embeddings are experiencing timeouts. Our engineers have identified the cause and deployed a fix; full recovery is expected within the next 90 minutes.

If you need an immediate workaround, you can switch to small-batch ingestion (we can help). We’re also hosting a live troubleshooting office hour and offering a one-time onboarding credit (covers ~1 week of ingest quota) for affected customers.

Office hours: Thu Mar 26, 16:00 UTC — https://cal.me/redwood/embeds-office-hours

If you’d like us to apply the mitigation for you or schedule a 1:1 migration session, reply to this message and we’ll prioritize you.

Thanks for your patience — 
The Redwood Onboarding Team
```

lia_onboarding: LGTM. Suggest adding: "If you'd like a migration workshop, we can book a 30-min session" for high-value accounts and include feedback form: https://forms.redwood.ai/ingest-feedback

matt_reliability: Once we confirm full roll to 100% I'll update the ETA sentence to an exact time (e.g., "expected full restore by 12:45 UTC").

opsbot: Office hours scheduled: Thu 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC — https://cal.me/redwood/embeds-office-hours (auto-created)

anna_cs: I'll start sending to trial accounts first and then prioritized high-touch customers after 2nd confirmation from eng. @exec_cx FYI — will need renewal-risk flags on any accounts that report loss of progress or express churn risk. :heart:

exec_cx: Acknowledged. I'll flag 3 accounts that are in renewals this quarter and loop our AE team.

sanjay_eng: Patch rolled out to all regions at +70m. Monitoring: no 5xx for the last 30m across ingestion fleet. We’ll publish a detailed RCA in the incident doc with timeline and permanent remediation (we're adding an integration test to catch the splitter edge-case).

anna_cs: Final plan: outbound as drafted with small tweaks (add workshop, feedback link, explicit ETA once confirmed). Offer: one-time credit (one week ingest quota) + 30-min migration session if requested. I'll post the final message to #customer-success/outbound after minor edits and attach the CSV of affected tenants for personalized outreach. Thanks everyone.
